desc: While this bowl is filled with water, you can use an action to speak the bowl's command word and summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.namJz755U1EhvEJa]{Water Elemental}, as if you had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.1LkZvINag7KqBmDR]{Conjure Elemental} spell. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It weighs 3 pounds and holds about 3 gallons.
name: bowl of commanding water elementals
